invariants: Only *.json files in the target directory are read, in sorted filename order.
Every file must parse as JSON and satisfy the strict manifest schema; any failure aborts the load with RegistryLoadError naming all bad files.
Unknown manifest fields are rejected (strict schema).
Filtering uses exact equality for version and stack; capabilities and dependencies use AND semantics with exact matches.
Output order is always (id, version) ascending, independent of read order.
